exposure: cardiac surgery using cardiopulmonary bypass during pregnancy
cohort: Twenty-nine pregnant patients with a median age of 28 years underwent cardiac surgery using cardiopulmonary bypass at a single center from 1978 to 2023.
finding: Cardiac surgery during pregnancy was associated with low maternal mortality (3%) but significant fetal mortality (17% overall, 29% for continuing pregnancies).
mod_finding: The study suggests considering cesarean delivery before cardiopulmonary bypass procedures if the fetus is of a viable gestational age to minimize mortality.
gest_age: Median 25 weeks (IQR 16-29 weeks) at surgery; median 25 weeks (IQR 21-26 weeks) in cases of fetal loss; median 23 weeks (IQR 20-29 weeks) in cases without fetal loss.
